name: Handout 1: Legate's Orders
player_description:
MANDATUM LEGATI MARCI AURELII CORVINI
Ad milites electos:
Descendite in ruinas. Recuperate telum divinum.
Nemo tangat telum nisi ego permitto.

(To the chosen soldiers: Descend into the ruins. Recover the divine weapon. No one shall touch the weapon unless I permit it.)

In nomine Senatus Populique Romani.
gm_notes:
WHEN: Session 1, Scene 1, when Corvinus summons the party.
HOW: Copy onto narrow parchment strip. Latin + English so players feel immediacy.
WHAT IT REVEALS: Corvinus already knows about the spear. This is a military order, not a request. The final clause ('unless I permit it') reveals his intentions — he wants exclusive control before anyone else learns what it is.
